excel.title: Import properties from the approved template
excel.intro: Use the approved Kutayyib workbook: one sheet per property, preserving cell positions and labels.
excel.step1: Download the template and enter your property data instead of creating a new table.
excel.step2: Use one sheet per property. Duplicate sheets or delete unused ones; do not move cells or change labels.
excel.step3: Upload the .xlsx file, review the preview and import all properties after correcting errors.
excel.guide: How to fill in the template
excel.required: Required: description D5, type D7, area F7 (greater than zero), and deed number D8. Store deed, plot and plan identifiers as text to preserve leading zeros.
excel.formats: Closing date D3: day/month/year. Time E3: 17:30 or 5:30 PM. Enter the deposit F10 and lengths I14:I17 as numbers without units. Do not use formulas.
excel.links: Survey, additional images and location URLs go in I20, I21 and I22, or as hyperlinks on H20, H21 and H22. Use full http(s) URLs. Upload images in the images step after importing.
excel.missing: The template has no city field; complete it in the property form after import. Leave unknown values blank; **** and / are never converted into assumed data.
excel.wrongType: Select an .xlsx file using the approved template. PDF, images, CSV and .xls are not supported here.
excel.wrongSize: Select a nonempty file no larger than 10 MB.
excel.blocked: No properties have been saved. Correct every error and upload again; invalid sheets are never silently skipped.
excel.acknowledge: I reviewed the warnings and agree to import the displayed values. I will complete missing fields before generating the booklet.

issues.layout: Template layout mismatch. Expected “{expected}” here. Use the approved template without moving cells.
issues.missing_optional: This incomplete value will remain blank; complete it before approving property details.
issues.formula: Formulas and Excel errors are not supported. Replace with a direct value.
issues.number: Enter a valid nonnegative number; area must be greater than zero.
issues.date: Invalid date. Use day/month/year, for example 29/07/2026.
issues.link: Enter a valid, complete http(s) URL.
issues.invalid: Invalid value or field limit exceeded: {field}.
issues.duplicate: Duplicate property with the same deed, plan and plot. Remove the duplicate sheet.
issues.already_imported: This deed, plan and plot already exist in the project. Edit the existing property instead.
issues.identifier_precision: Excel may have rounded this long identifier. Enter it as text from the original source.
issues.conflicting_links: Two different links were supplied. Keep one link in the input cell or its label.
issues.city_missing: The template has no city field. Complete it in the property form after importing.
issues.dates_differ: Closing dates differ between properties. Check the day, month and year; values will be preserved as entered.
issues.unsupported_cell: Data was found outside supported template cells. Move it to the correct field or remove it to avoid losing it.

excel.cityHelp: The template has no city cell. Set a common city here, or complete it separately for each property after import.
